in_hebrew.name: צדקיאל
in_hebrew.meaning: צדק אלוהים משמעות הצדק הוא אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם צדקיאל מורכב משתי מילים עבריות: צדק ו אל. צדק פירושו צדיקות, צדק, ואל מתייחס לאלוהים. לכן, השם צדקיאל יכול להתפרש כ'צדק הוא אלוהים' או 'אלוהים הוא הצדק'. השם צדקיאל מופיע בתפילה היהודית ומשמש כשם לאחד המלאכים המשמשים כשליחים של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ζαδκίηλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ζαδκίηλ προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: τζάντ (צדק) που σημαίνει δικαιοσύνη και ελ (אל) που αναφέρεται στο Θεό. Στο Χριστιανισμό και την Ιουδαϊκή παράδοση, ο Ζαδκίηλ θεωρείται ένας από τους άγγελους που υπηρετούν ως αγγελιοφόροι του Θεού, συμβολίζοντας τη δικαιοσύνη και τη συμπόνια του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Zadkiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zadkiel derivatur ex lingua Hebraea, componitur ex duobus vocabulis: tzadik (צדק), quod significat justitiam, et El (אל), quod refertur ad Deum. In traditione Christiana et Judaica, Zadkiel habetur unus ex angelis qui serviunt ut nuntii Dei, significans justitiam et misericordiam Dei.

in_english.name: Zadkiela
in_english.meaning: God is my righteousness or God is just
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zadkiela originates from Hebrew roots, composed of 'tzadik' (צדק) meaning righteousness or justice, and 'El' (אל) referring to God. Zadkiela is interpreted as 'God is my righteousness' or 'God is just'. In Christian tradition, Zadkiel is considered one of the archangels, often associated with mercy, justice, and the transformation of souls. The name signifies a strong spiritual connection to divine justice and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zadkiela has its roots in the Old Testament and carries cultural significance in Jewish and Christian traditions. Zadkiel was a prince of the Priests (the sons of Aaron), who is known for his righteousness and faithfulness to God. In the New Testament book of Matthew, an angel of God is referred to as "the name of the angel is Raphael: whose interprettation is, He that hath been healed by the God of Israel: but thou shalt be called by his name Zadok" (Matthew 25:31). This suggests that Zadkiel was seen as a healer or helper sent from God.Overall, Zadkiela reminds us of the importance of righteousness and justice in our lives and the role of angels as helpers and protectors sent from God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zadkiela carries deep spiritual significance as it is rooted in God's righteousness and justice, which are important aspects of faith. The name calls us to strive for righteousness in our thoughts, words, and actions. It is a reminder of God's presence in our lives and the importance of seeking His guidance and justice. The name Zadkiela also highlights the role of angels as spiritual helpers and guides in our journey towards God. It serves as a source of comfort and encouragement, reminding us that we are not alone in our struggles and that God is always with us. Ultimately, the name Zadkiela is a powerful reminder of God's presence, love, and justice.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zadkiela is a Hebrew name meaning "righteousness of God." It is believed to be the name of an archangel who embodies divine mercy, compassion, and justice. In times of spiritual distress, Zadkiela is invoked to bring peace, forgiveness, and healing.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, Zadkiel is recognized in Judaic and Christian traditions as an archangel.

historical_references.reference:
Zadkiel is mentioned as a leader of the Essenes, an ascetic Jewish sect, around the time of the Second Temple period. He is also believed to have been the high priest at the time of the crucifixion of Jesus.
Time period: Between 150 BC and 70 AD
Context: Jewish sect with ascetic practices and a belief in an angelic hierarchy, with Zadkiel as a leader and high priest.

In later Christian tradition, Zadkiel is identified as an archangel who presides over the time of prayer in the Temple of God and over the prayerful souls of the faithful.
Time period: After the Second Temple period
Context: Christian belief in the existence of a hierarchy of angels, with Zadkiel as an archangel in charge of prayer.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Christian name 'Zadkiela' has gained popularity in modern spiritual circles, particularly in the contexts of New Age spirituality, Angelic Reiki, and metaphysics. In social media platforms like Facebook groups and YouTube channels, individuals and communities practice and discuss various forms of spirituality, with 'Zadkiela' often being invoked as a high-ranking angel or ascended master. At spiritual retreats, workshops, and seminars, the name is used in meditation and healing practices, symbolizing divine protection, love, and wisdom.
